description:
You are one of several planners at a logistics company choosing where to build a new regional warehouse. Each planner has surveyed different aspects of the candidate sites.

The options are:
- Site A (Talumeri Quothori)
- Site B (Fenbrefen Belpol)
- Site C (Ozwel Ricasith)
- Site D (Nemir Drabrelu)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which site should be chosen? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Site A (Talumeri Quothori):
  - Site A would require a zoning change
  - Site A has no fibre broadband available
  - Site A has a contamination finding on record
  - Site A has supportive neighbouring businesses
  - Site A has insufficient grid capacity
  - Site A is 21 minutes from the nearest city centre
  - Site A is priced at 430 per square metre
Site B (Fenbrefen Belpol):
  - Site B has room for future expansion
  - Site B has restricted water supply
  - Site B is in a low-crime area
  - Site B has unstable soil requiring piling
  - Site B is priced at 184 per square metre
Site C (Ozwel Ricasith):
  - Site C has a rail spur connection
  - Site C has supportive neighbouring businesses
  - Site C would require a zoning change
  - Site C has stable soil for heavy foundations
  - Site C saw 8 weather-related road closures last year
Site D (Nemir Drabrelu):
  - Site D has a slow permitting history
  - Site D is in a high-crime area
  - Site D has sufficient grid capacity
  - Site D saw 0 weather-related road closures last year
  - Site D is priced at 427 per square metre
